title: New York Week-Edge Entry-State Audit
question: Do native portfolio entries born on the New York market week's Monday reopening edge or Friday closing edge have a material and temporally broad stressed-R and stop-incidence difference from Tuesday-through-Thursday entries of the same strategy and fresh period?
hypothesis: The two natural market-week edges may carry distinct price-discovery, inventory and positioning conditions that are not represented by the frozen intraday server-wall schedules. A genuine week-edge entry state should show a material return/stop separation from same-strategy-period midweek births, coherent economic signs and breadth across periods and strategies.
why_now: After the Program 4 Unit 046 invalid closure, a whole-map comparison gives the recent durable sequence Program 7 then 5 then 2 then 4. Program 1's broad prior-signal proposal was already rejected on structural concentration. Program 3 has not been allocated since Unit 042, and this dense natural calendar partition is independent of RC4 management, VIX, lot allocation and evidence-path meta work.

immutable_inputs.economic_identity: exact frozen CP2 observation-equivalent shared portfolio control

current_path_hash_manifest.algorithm: Sort root-relative path|uppercase file SHA-256, join with LF, SHA-256 UTF-8.

clock_contract.server_zone: Windows FLE Standard Time; UTC+2/+3 under the frozen FPMarkets/Europe transition rule.
clock_contract.new_york_zone: Windows Eastern Standard Time; UTC-5/-4 under the frozen US transition rule.
clock_contract.conversion: Parse server_time as an unspecified FLE wall-clock instant, convert to UTC, then convert UTC to Eastern Standard Time before taking DayOfWeek.

pre_outcome_feasibility.scope: Only admitted birth event, exact component identity, server timestamp, derived New York weekday and fresh period were used. No close value, stressed R, stop association, weekday-conditioned economics, gate or verdict was accessed.

fixed_reconstruction.event_identity: Preserve every distinct full CSV row; state_sequence is not a primary event key.
fixed_reconstruction.ordering: Within each period order by parsed server_time, numeric state_sequence, close-before-birth precedence, then source path and line.
fixed_reconstruction.exact_component_selection: Use only the six complete component_id keys in strategy_identity. Prefix, suffix, substring, wildcard and inferred-family selectors are prohibited.
fixed_reconstruction.market_birth: OPEN begins RC16, RC4, Cross, Pressure or Return and supplies positive planned_risk from detail.
fixed_reconstruction.passive_pending: PASSIVE_PLACE stores one positive planned risk; PASSIVE_EXPIRE clears it and PASSIVE_FILL begins Passive with the active risk.
fixed_reconstruction.close: CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE ends the active lifecycle; value_b is frozen 2x-cost stressed net USD and EXTERNAL_CLOSE is a stop-loss exit.
fixed_reconstruction.stressed_r: Close value_b divided by positive birth planned_risk.
fixed_reconstruction.weekday_role: Assign exactly once at birth using clock_contract.
fixed_reconstruction.midweek_benchmark: For each of 24 strategy x P1-P4 cells, compute mean stressed R and stop rate from Tuesday-through-Thursday lifecycles only.
fixed_reconstruction.edge_residuals: For each Monday or Friday lifecycle subtract its same-strategy-period midweek benchmark stressed R and stop rate.

fixed_metrics.role_report: For Monday, midweek and Friday report n, 2x stressed net, mean stressed R, stop rate and positive rate by pooled, period and strategy views.
fixed_metrics.variant_report: For each edge report equal-lifecycle pooled mean stressed-R residual and stop residual, four period residual means, six strategy residual means and contribution shares.
fixed_metrics.period_contribution_share: Absolute period residual-sum divided by the sum of absolute residual-sums across four periods.
fixed_metrics.strategy_contribution_share: Absolute strategy residual-sum divided by the sum of absolute residual-sums across six strategies.

fixed_integrity_gate: The session-clock source and all six event files retain their exact byte lengths and hashes.
Retain 16,477 data rows with zero exact duplicate full rows.

Reconstruct exactly 2,233 lifecycles with strategy totals RC16 272, RC4 206, Cross 805, Pressure 118, Return 238 and Passive 594, 407.0477 USD 2x stressed net and 206 stop exits with zero pairing, overlap, risk, close or weekday fault.
Reproduce exact weekday, role, period-role and strategy-role counts frozen in pre_outcome_feasibility with zero weekend birth.
Reconstruct exactly 24 finite nonempty strategy-period midweek benchmark cells and retain every lifecycle in exactly one weekday role.

density: Treatment and midweek comparator reproduce their exact frozen pooled, period, strategy and strategy-period counts.
Treatment has at least 65 lifecycles in every period and at least 25 in every strategy.
Every strategy-period treatment cell has at least three lifecycles and every midweek cell at least 12.
information: Absolute pooled mean stressed-R residual is at least 0.10R.
Absolute pooled mean stop residual is at least 0.05.
The pooled channels are economically concordant: negative R requires positive stop residual, while positive R requires negative stop residual.
Stressed-R residual shares the pooled sign in at least three of four periods and four of six strategies.
Stop residual shares the pooled sign in at least three of four periods and four of six strategies.
No one period contributes more than 60% and no one strategy more than 50% of the absolute stressed-R residual numerator.
fixed_variant_gates.pass_rule: A variant passes only if every density and information requirement passes. Zero is never counted as a sign.

fixed_bundle_gate.authority_limit: This is consumed-data association, not causal proof. A passing variant may retain at most one later entry-preserving timing-context question after a future whole-map comparison; it selects no filter, order shift, session change, EA or Live behavior now.
fixed_bundle_gate.selection_if_any_pass: If exactly one passes, retain only that edge. If both pass, prefer neither automatically; record their common or divergent signs and park both until a later whole-map comparison.
